title: Chapter 1184
text:
The day after the meeting, the Beyond Grade A Association released a statement under the influence of Han Xiao.

The statement stated that the Modo Civilization had plotted against other Beyond Grade As and friends in order to frame Black Star, which violated the rules of the association. In order to protect the interests of the members, the association strongly condemned Modo's actions and approved of Black Star's counterattack. Furthermore, the association did not deny the possibility of personally intervening to protect the interests of the members.

As soon as the announcement was released, it caused a strong reaction in the Flickering World. The ones with the biggest reaction were the various organizations on the frontlines of the Flickering War.

Ever since the start of the war, most of the Beyond Grade As had been observing the situation and not intervening. Now, was this a sign that they were going to personally take action?

Although the association claimed that they were going to deal with the Modo Civilization, the armed forces on the side of the three Universal Civilizations were not happy.

Everyone knew that the Beyond Grade As were the weapons of the Ultimate Soldiers. Plus, the intensity of the war was controlled. Once the Beyond Grade As intervened, they would definitely become the main force in the war. The others would not even be able to get anything.

The angriest of all was the Supercluster Alliance. If not for the fact that they were all allies, they would have even turned around and attacked the Modo Civilization!

The Supercluster Alliance only wanted Modo to resist the invasion of the Black Star Corps and not do anything unnecessary. However, because of their different standpoints, Modo had to plan for themselves. Now, they had directly poked the hornet's nest and became the biggest unexpected factor in the war.

Unlike in the past, the Beyond Grade As had established a collective association, turning from a sheet of loose sand into a barely organized group. Once provoked, they would form a nest, and their influence would be extraordinary. If not for the fact that the association was in a conflict of interests with the three Universal Civilizations, giving the Supercluster Alliance an advantage, they would not have dared to say that they had no chance of winning this war.

It did not make sense to say that Aesop was not involved. He had helped the Black Star Corps find the secret transportation routes of the Modo Civilization. However, this part was deliberately left out by the association, only emphasizing his relationship with the Dragon Emperor and the fact that the Dragon Emperor did not participate in this matter.

From a reasonable point of view, the Modo Civilization had not gone overboard. It was clearly Aesop who helped Black Star deal with them first. However, using this to reason with the association would only bring shame to themselves. The reason for this was Black Star's power. In order to restrain a power, the only way was to use greater power. It was just like using the right medicine to treat the illness. Reasoning was useless in itself. It was equivalent to using the wrong medicine.

The current Supercluster Alliance naturally did not have the power to suppress the Beyond Grade A Association. In the entire universe, only the three Universal Civilizations had the power to do so. However, this matter was beneficial to them, so of course, they would not stand out to undermine the Beyond Grade A Association. Thus, they all remained silent and agreed.

The situation seemed to be developing in a direction that was beneficial to the three Universal Civilizations. However, while the upper echelons of the three Universal Civilizations were happy, their feelings were somewhat complicated.

"Black Star … is gaining more and more power."

On the mother planet of the Radiant Federation, President Bader looked at the report and let out a long sigh.

The direct Beyond Grade A Supers had already handed the details of the meeting to him. Although the person involved was Ames, with this woman's personality, she would not ask for help from outsiders. The change in the association's attitude this time was completely driven by Black Star.

The moment the Black Star Corps made the announcement, Black Star had influenced the association to react, using his identity and position to complete the mobilization of resources that were beneficial to his actions. Most of the time, the specific form of power was the ability to mobilize others. A person who could make many people act according to his wishes was considered a person with power and influence.

The advanced civilizations had done this many times. As long as it was a good method, it did not matter if it was black or white.

Before the establishment of the Beyond Grade A Association, if Black Star wanted to borrow power, the only method he could use was to complain to the Red Empire.

Now, he had promoted the establishment of the Beyond Grade A Association, creating a new backing and a new source of power for himself. He had more resources and platforms in his hands than before, and his position in the galactic society was getting higher and higher.

In contrast, although Manison was the president of a higher level, Han Xiao had gradually taken away a lot of his speaking rights. This was partly due to the three Universal Civilizations adding fuel to the fire, but the Mecha Empire was still an ally of the Radiant Federation in name after all, so Bader was somewhat unhappy.

What made him feel the most conflicted was the unity shown by the association this time. The way Bader saw it, these Beyond Grade As were not speaking to the entire universe but telling the three Universal Civilizations that they were no longer a sheet of loose sand. This was an indirect demonstration.

Although some Beyond Grade As still had different thoughts, they had a common goal. If they were left alone, it could be foreseen that the control of the three Universal Civilizations over the Beyond Grade A group would gradually weaken over time.

"Sigh …" Bader rubbed his temples and felt a headache coming on.

As the leader of an advanced civilization, there were too many layers to consider when it came to a single matter. Even though there were specialized medical personnel to take care of his body and keep him full of energy, his long career as a leader had exhausted too much of his mental and physical strength, causing damage to his mental state.

However, the day of the leadership change was not far away, and his term was almost over.

Not only the Radiance, but Uranril on the Red Empire's side was also about to step down.

These problems could only be left to the future generations to worry about.

…

Free competition zone, Emerald Star Cluster, Ferdinand Battle Zone.

On this day, countless battleships of the Black Star Army gathered around a temporary space base. Almost seventy to eighty percent of the fleets that the Black Star Army had sent to the frontlines were gathered here. There were countless normal army warriors and players.

Such a gathering was usually for large-scale military operations, but today, it was just to welcome a few people.

In one of the battleships, many players squeezed in front of the porthole and stared at the temporary blue stargate next to the base.

"The notice said that Black Star will be here today. Why isn't he here yet?"

"Is there a traffic jam in the stargate?"

Everyone discussed softly.

They were supposed to be fighting on the frontlines and continue to fight with the enemy guild alliance, but not long ago, Philip gave a new order to most of the members to retreat and wait for Black Star's arrival in the base.

The players' attention was mainly on the Nation War. Recently, the conflict between Black Star and the Mecha Empire was also discussed on the forums, but it was not as popular as their own Nation War for the time being.

The reaction of the army players after knowing about this was almost the same. They basically shouted 'Army Commander is awesome' and continued to chase after the enemy guild players.

Regarding the news that Black Star was going to take action personally, some of the new foreign players were pleasantly surprised and looked forward to fighting alongside Han Xiao.

However, the more experienced Chinese players felt extremely desperate, and their thoughts were shockingly similar.

Don't f * cking come, we don't want to watch CG again!

Hum!

At this time, a black conical ship protruded out of the blue vortex of the stargate, followed by a black armored hull. A huge main ship sailed out of the stargate, followed by a fleet of battleships. The scene seemed to be filtered out of the stargate.

In the command room at the front of the main ship, the viewing window switched to two-way transparency. The players present could clearly see Han Xiao and Ames standing in front of the porthole of the main ship.

"They're out, they're out!"

"Black Star! Dragon Emperor! "

"Ah! Seeing the long-legged big sister with my own eyes, I have no regrets in my life! "

"Don't stop me, I'm going to lick her until she explodes today!"

"Sigh, after watching the main character of Black Star's movie, Fu Ding, and seeing him in person, it turns out that this is called the distance between imagination and reality."

"Just the thought of Black Star being able to arrange his legs in any position, my heart breaks. Wuwuwu …"

"They're a perfect match. Who are you to object?"

Many people had not seen Han Xiao for a long time and were very excited. However, in terms of popularity, Ames completely crushed him. The players' cries and screams came from all the spaceships.

In the command room of the main ship, Ames looked at the fleet outside the window and asked, "Are these enough people?"

"With the two of us, of course, it's enough." Han Xiao nodded.

After making the announcement, the two of them rushed to the frontline to fulfill their promise, deciding to attack the Modo Civilization personally.

At this time, a remote projection appeared beside the two of them. It was the commander-in-chief of the frontline fleet, Herlous.

"Sirs, the troops have been assembled according to the instructions. What should we do next?"

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes, curled his lips, and said, "Of course, we'll give the Modo Civilization a gift first."

Hearing this, a gleam flashed across Ames' eyes, and she was eager to try.

This was the plan they had discussed on the way here. From the captives, they learned that the plan to ambush Aesop was first thought of by the commanders of the Modo expeditionary army. Therefore, the two of them made a decision … as soon as they arrived at the frontline, they would go straight to the root of the problem and kill the culprit first!

"However, before we have fun with Modo, let's get rid of the people who are in the way first." Han Xiao's tone changed. "In the Ferdinand Theater, have you found out all the organizations that followed behind the Black Star Corps?"

"Yes." Herlous nodded.

The Black Star Corps' target had always been the Modo Civilization. Some of the affiliated organizations of the three Universal Civilizations took the opportunity when the Black Star Corps broke through the frontline to attack from behind, constantly encroaching on Modo's territory, wanting to use this place as a breakthrough point in the war.

"Okay, contact all the commanders of these troops and pull them into the communication channel."

Then, Han Xiao closed his eyes and waited for a while. In less than ten minutes, the commanders of these organizations entered the channel one after another.

It was way too easy to contact them. Hearing that it was Black Star looking for them, none of them rejected and accepted the communication request obediently.

In the channel, voices appeared one after another. Not long after, everyone was there. It was noisy.

Han Xiao then opened his eyes and said, "Hello, everyone.

I'm Black Star. "

"Greetings, Your Excellency Black Star!" "Hello, Mr. Black Star." "Have you eaten?"

The channel went silent for a moment. Everyone hurriedly greeted him. Just from their tone, one could imagine the fear on their faces.

Han Xiao nodded and went straight to the point. "Everyone, please give me some face and leave the Ferdinand Theater. Don't waste your time here."

Everyone was stunned and at a loss for words. They didn't know how to respond.

The channel became silent.

Some people were dissatisfied. They thought that Black Star wanted to take all the benefits for himself and wanted them to leave with just one sentence.

"Er, Your Excellency Black Star, that doesn't seem very appropriate. Plus, we can help. With us helping you deal with the small fries that escaped, your losses will be reduced. Plus, we'll be moving around the periphery, eliminating the possibility of the Modo Civilization or other enemies surrounding the Black Star Corps," someone argued.

"Yes, yes, yes. We all know that you're eager for revenge, but with our help, you can get rid of the Modo Civilization expeditionary army faster. There's strength in numbers," many people immediately agreed.

Of course, I'm just afraid that you guys will beat Modo and give up too quickly … I can only torture them to my heart's content if they don't surrender.

"I don't want to emphasize it a second time. In short, I hope that everyone will leave the Ferdinand Theater within five days."

Han Xiao said slowly with a low tone.

"I'll take over this battlefront!"
